en.text: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel with all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，所罗门将以色列的长老和各支派的首领，并以色列的族长，招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和华的约柜从大卫城—就是锡安—运上来。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，所羅門將以色列的長老和各支派的首領，並以色列的族長，招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和華的約櫃從大衛城－就是錫安－運上來。

en.text: All the men of Israel assembled themselves to King Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

zhSimplified.text: 以他念月，就是七月，在节前，以色列人都聚集到所罗门王那里。

zhTraditional.text: 以他念月，就是七月，在節前，以色列人都聚集到所羅門王那裏。

en.text: All the elders of Israel came, and the priests picked up the ark.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列长老来到，祭司便抬起约柜，

zhTraditional.text: 以色列長老來到，祭司便抬起約櫃，

en.text: They brought up the LORD’s ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The priests and the Levites brought these up.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司和利未人将耶和华的约柜运上来，又将会幕和会幕的一切圣器具都带上来。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司和利未人將耶和華的約櫃運上來，又將會幕和會幕的一切聖器具都帶上來。

en.text: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were assembled to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门王和聚集到他那里的以色列全会众，一同在约柜前献牛羊为祭，多得不可胜数。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門王和聚集到他那裏的以色列全會眾，一同在約櫃前獻牛羊為祭，多得不可勝數。

en.text: The priests brought in the ark of the LORD’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the cherubim’s wings.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司将耶和华的约柜抬进内殿，就是至圣所，放在两个基路伯的翅膀底下。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司將耶和華的約櫃抬進內殿，就是至聖所，放在兩個基路伯的翅膀底下。

en.text: For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

zhSimplified.text: 基路伯张着翅膀在约柜之上，遮掩约柜和抬柜的杠。

zhTraditional.text: 基路伯張着翅膀在約櫃之上，遮掩約櫃和抬櫃的槓。

en.text: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the holy place before the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside. They are there to this day.

zhSimplified.text: 这杠甚长，杠头在内殿前的圣所可以看见，在殿外却不能看见，直到如今还在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 這槓甚長，槓頭在內殿前的聖所可以看見，在殿外卻不能看見，直到如今還在那裏。

en.text: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

zhSimplified.text: 约柜里惟有两块石版，就是以色列人出埃及地后，耶和华与他们立约的时候摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，并无别物。

zhTraditional.text: 約櫃裏惟有兩塊石版，就是以色列人出埃及地後，耶和華與他們立約的時候摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，並無別物。

en.text: It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the LORD’s house,

zhSimplified.text: 祭司从圣所出来的时候，有云充满耶和华的殿；

zhTraditional.text: 祭司從聖所出來的時候，有雲充滿耶和華的殿；

en.text: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the LORD’s glory filled the LORD’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 甚至祭司不能站立供职，因为耶和华的荣光充满了殿。

zhTraditional.text: 甚至祭司不能站立供職，因為耶和華的榮光充滿了殿。

en.text: Then Solomon said, “The LORD has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

zhSimplified.text: 那时所罗门说： 耶和华曾说， 他必住在幽暗之处。

zhTraditional.text: 那時所羅門說： 耶和華曾說， 他必住在幽暗之處。

en.text: I have surely built you a house of habitation, a place for you to dwell in forever.”

zhSimplified.text: 我已经建造殿宇作你的居所， 为你永远的住处。 （代下6·3—11）

zhTraditional.text: 我已經建造殿宇作你的居所， 為你永遠的住處。 （代下6‧3－11）

en.text: The king turned his face around and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.

zhSimplified.text: 王转脸为以色列会众祝福，以色列会众就都站立。

zhTraditional.text: 王轉臉為以色列會眾祝福，以色列會眾就都站立。

en.text: He said, “Blessed is the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David your father, and has with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门说：「耶和华—以色列的 神是应当称颂的！因他亲口向我父大卫所应许的，也亲手成就了。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝是應當稱頌的！因他親口向我父大衛所應許的，也親手成就了。

en.text: ‘Since the day that I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house, that my name might be there; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.’

zhSimplified.text: 他说：『自从我领我民以色列出埃及以来，我未曾在以色列各支派中选择一城建造殿宇—为我名的居所，但拣选大卫治理我民以色列。』」

zhTraditional.text: 他說：『自從我領我民以色列出埃及以來，我未曾在以色列各支派中選擇一城建造殿宇－為我名的居所，但揀選大衛治理我民以色列。』」

en.text: “Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门说：「我父大卫曾立意，要为耶和华—以色列 神的名建殿。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門說：「我父大衛曾立意，要為耶和華－以色列上帝的名建殿。

en.text: But the LORD said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华却对我父大卫说：『你立意为我的名建殿，这意思甚好。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華卻對我父大衛說：『你立意為我的名建殿，這意思甚好。

en.text: Nevertheless, you shall not build the house; but your son who shall come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’

zhSimplified.text: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的儿子必为我名建殿。』

zhTraditional.text: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的兒子必為我名建殿。』

en.text: The LORD has established his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 现在耶和华成就了他所应许的话，使我接续我父大卫坐以色列的国位，又为耶和华—以色列 神的名建造了殿。

zhTraditional.text: 現在耶和華成就了他所應許的話，使我接續我父大衛坐以色列的國位，又為耶和華－以色列上帝的名建造了殿。

en.text: There I have set a place for the ark, in which is the LORD’s covenant, which he made with our fathers when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.”

zhSimplified.text: 我也在其中为约柜预备一处。约柜内有耶和华的约，就是他领我们列祖出埃及地的时候，与他们所立的约。」 （代下6·12—42）

zhTraditional.text: 我也在其中為約櫃預備一處。約櫃內有耶和華的約，就是他領我們列祖出埃及地的時候，與他們所立的約。」 （代下6‧12－42）

en.text: Solomon stood before the LORD’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven;

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门当着以色列会众，站在耶和华的坛前，向天举手说：

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門當着以色列會眾，站在耶和華的壇前，向天舉手說：

en.text: and he said, “LORD, the God of Israel, there is no God like you, in heaven above, or on earth beneath; who keeps covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

zhSimplified.text: 「耶和华—以色列的 神啊，天上地下没有神可比你的！你向那尽心行在你面前的仆人守约施慈爱；

zhTraditional.text: 「耶和華－以色列的上帝啊，天上地下沒有神可比你的！你向那盡心行在你面前的僕人守約施慈愛；

en.text: who has kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.

zhSimplified.text: 向你仆人—我父大卫所应许的话现在应验了。你亲口应许，亲手成就，正如今日一样。

zhTraditional.text: 向你僕人－我父大衛所應許的話現在應驗了。你親口應許，親手成就，正如今日一樣。

en.text: Now therefore, may LORD, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk before me as you have walked before me.’

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—以色列的 神啊，你所应许你仆人—我父大卫的话说：『你的子孙若谨慎自己的行为，在我面前行事像你所行的一样，就不断人坐以色列的国位。』现在求你应验这话。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－以色列的上帝啊，你所應許你僕人－我父大衛的話說：『你的子孫若謹慎自己的行為，在我面前行事像你所行的一樣，就不斷人坐以色列的國位。』現在求你應驗這話。

en.text: “Now therefore, God of Israel, please let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David my father.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列的 神啊，求你成就向你仆人—我父大卫所应许的话。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列的上帝啊，求你成就向你僕人－我父大衛所應許的話。

en.text: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house that I have built!

zhSimplified.text: 「 神果真住在地上吗？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何况我所建的这殿呢？

zhTraditional.text: 「上帝果真住在地上嗎？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何況我所建的這殿呢？

en.text: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and for his supplication, LORD my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you today;

zhSimplified.text: 惟求耶和华—我的 神垂顾仆人的祷告祈求，俯听仆人今日在你面前的祈祷呼吁。

zhTraditional.text: 惟求耶和華－我的上帝垂顧僕人的禱告祈求，俯聽僕人今日在你面前的祈禱呼籲。

en.text: that your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which you have said, ‘My name shall be there;’ to listen to the prayer which your servant prays toward this place.

zhSimplified.text: 愿你昼夜看顾这殿，就是你应许立为你名的居所；求你垂听仆人向此处祷告的话。

zhTraditional.text: 願你晝夜看顧這殿，就是你應許立為你名的居所；求你垂聽僕人向此處禱告的話。

en.text: Listen to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear in heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.

zhSimplified.text: 你仆人和你民以色列向此处祈祷的时候，求你在天上你的居所垂听，垂听而赦免。

zhTraditional.text: 你僕人和你民以色列向此處祈禱的時候，求你在天上你的居所垂聽，垂聽而赦免。

en.text: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,

zhSimplified.text: 「人若得罪邻舍，有人叫他起誓，他来到这殿在你的坛前起誓，

zhTraditional.text: 「人若得罪鄰舍，有人叫他起誓，他來到這殿在你的壇前起誓，

en.text: then hear in heaven, and act, and judge your servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way on his own head, and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

zhSimplified.text: 求你在天上垂听，判断你的仆人：定恶人有罪，照他所行的报应在他头上；定义人有理，照他的义赏赐他。

zhTraditional.text: 求你在天上垂聽，判斷你的僕人：定惡人有罪，照他所行的報應在他頭上；定義人有理，照他的義賞賜他。

en.text: “When your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you, if they turn again to you and confess your name, and pray and make supplication to you in this house,

zhSimplified.text: 「你的民以色列若得罪你，败在仇敌面前，又归向你，承认你的名，在这殿里祈求祷告，

zhTraditional.text: 「你的民以色列若得罪你，敗在仇敵面前，又歸向你，承認你的名，在這殿裏祈求禱告，

en.text: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to their fathers.

zhSimplified.text: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他们归回你赐给他们列祖之地。

zhTraditional.text: 求你在天上垂聽，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他們歸回你賜給他們列祖之地。

en.text: “When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,

zhSimplified.text: 「你的民因得罪你，你惩罚他们，使天闭塞不下雨；他们若向此处祷告，承认你的名，离开他们的罪，

zhTraditional.text: 「你的民因得罪你，你懲罰他們，使天閉塞不下雨；他們若向此處禱告，承認你的名，離開他們的罪，

en.text: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk; and send rain on your land which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

zhSimplified.text: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你仆人以色列民的罪，将当行的善道指教他们，且降雨在你的地，就是你赐给你民为业之地。

zhTraditional.text: 求你在天上垂聽，赦免你僕人以色列民的罪，將當行的善道指教他們，且降雨在你的地，就是你賜給你民為業之地。

en.text: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight, mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemy besieges them in the land of their cities, whatever plague, whatever sickness there is,

zhSimplified.text: 「国中若有饥荒、瘟疫、旱风、霉烂、蝗虫、蚂蚱，或有仇敌犯境围困城邑，无论遭遇什么灾祸疾病，

zhTraditional.text: 「國中若有饑荒、瘟疫、旱風、霉爛、蝗蟲、螞蚱，或有仇敵犯境圍困城邑，無論遭遇甚麼災禍疾病，

en.text: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who shall each know the plague of his own heart, and spread out his hands toward this house,

zhSimplified.text: 你的民以色列，或是众人，或是一人，自觉有罪，向这殿举手，无论祈求什么，祷告什么，

zhTraditional.text: 你的民以色列，或是眾人，或是一人，自覺有罪，向這殿舉手，無論祈求甚麼，禱告甚麼，

en.text: then hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and forgive, and act, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of all the children of men);

zhSimplified.text: 求你在天上你的居所垂听赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他们（惟有你知道世人的心），

zhTraditional.text: 求你在天上你的居所垂聽赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他們（惟有你知道世人的心），

en.text: that they may fear you all the days that they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

zhSimplified.text: 使他们在你赐给我们列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你。

zhTraditional.text: 使他們在你賜給我們列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你。

en.text: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes out of a far country for your name’s sake

zhSimplified.text: 「论到不属你民以色列的外邦人，为你名从远方而来，

zhTraditional.text: 「論到不屬你民以色列的外邦人，為你名從遠方而來，

en.text: (for they shall hear of your great name and of your mighty hand and of your outstretched arm), when he comes and prays toward this house,

zhSimplified.text: （他们听人论说你的大名和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂）向这殿祷告，

zhTraditional.text: （他們聽人論說你的大名和大能的手，並伸出來的膀臂）向這殿禱告，

en.text: hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name, to fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.

zhSimplified.text: 求你在天上你的居所垂听，照着外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下万民都认识你的名，敬畏你像你的民以色列一样；又使他们知道我建造的这殿是称为你名下的。

zhTraditional.text: 求你在天上你的居所垂聽，照着外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下萬民都認識你的名，敬畏你像你的民以色列一樣；又使他們知道我建造的這殿是稱為你名下的。

en.text: “If your people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatever way you shall send them, and they pray to the LORD toward the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name,

zhSimplified.text: 「你的民若奉你的差遣，无论往何处去与仇敌争战，向耶和华所选择的城与我为你名所建造的殿祷告，

zhTraditional.text: 「你的民若奉你的差遣，無論往何處去與仇敵爭戰，向耶和華所選擇的城與我為你名所建造的殿禱告，

en.text: then hear in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

zhSimplified.text: 求你在天上垂听他们的祷告祈求，使他们得胜。

zhTraditional.text: 求你在天上垂聽他們的禱告祈求，使他們得勝。

en.text: If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to the land of the enemy, far off or near;

zhSimplified.text: 「你的民若得罪你（世上没有不犯罪的人），你向他们发怒，将他们交给仇敌掳到仇敌之地，或远或近，

zhTraditional.text: 「你的民若得罪你（世上沒有不犯罪的人），你向他們發怒，將他們交給仇敵擄到仇敵之地，或遠或近，

en.text: yet if they repent in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of those who carried them captive, saying, ‘We have sinned and have done perversely; we have dealt wickedly,’

zhSimplified.text: 他们若在掳到之地想起罪来，回心转意，恳求你说：『我们有罪了，我们悖逆了，我们作恶了』；

zhTraditional.text: 他們若在擄到之地想起罪來，回心轉意，懇求你說：『我們有罪了，我們悖逆了，我們作惡了』；

en.text: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies who carried them captive, and pray to you toward their land which you gave to their fathers, the city which you have chosen and the house which I have built for your name,

zhSimplified.text: 他们若在掳到之地尽心尽性归服你，又向自己的地，就是你赐给他们列祖之地和你所选择的城，并我为你名所建造的殿祷告，

zhTraditional.text: 他們若在擄到之地盡心盡性歸服你，又向自己的地，就是你賜給他們列祖之地和你所選擇的城，並我為你名所建造的殿禱告，

en.text: then hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven, your dwelling place, and maintain their cause;

zhSimplified.text: 求你在天上你的居所垂听他们的祷告祈求，为他们伸冤；

zhTraditional.text: 求你在天上你的居所垂聽他們的禱告祈求，為他們伸冤；

en.text: and forgive your people who have sinned against you, and all their transgressions in which they have transgressed against you; and give them compassion before those who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them

zhSimplified.text: 饶恕得罪你的民，赦免他们的一切过犯，使他们在掳他们的人面前蒙怜恤。

zhTraditional.text: 饒恕得罪你的民，赦免他們的一切過犯，使他們在擄他們的人面前蒙憐恤。

en.text: (for they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out of Egypt, from the middle of the iron furnace);

zhSimplified.text: 因为他们是你的子民，你的产业，是你从埃及领出来脱离铁炉的。

zhTraditional.text: 因為他們是你的子民，你的產業，是你從埃及領出來脫離鐵爐的。

en.text: that your eyes may be open to the supplication of your servant and to the supplication of your people Israel, to listen to them whenever they cry to you.

zhSimplified.text: 愿你的眼目看顾仆人，听你民以色列的祈求，无论何时向你祈求，愿你垂听。

zhTraditional.text: 願你的眼目看顧僕人，聽你民以色列的祈求，無論何時向你祈求，願你垂聽。

en.text: For you separated them from among all the peoples of the earth to be your inheritance, as you spoke by Moses your servant, when you brought our fathers out of Egypt, Lord GOD.”

zhSimplified.text: 主耶和华啊，你将他们从地上的万民中分别出来作你的产业，是照你领我们列祖出埃及的时候，借你仆人摩西所应许的话。」

zhTraditional.text: 主耶和華啊，你將他們從地上的萬民中分別出來作你的產業，是照你領我們列祖出埃及的時候，藉你僕人摩西所應許的話。」

en.text: It was so, that when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to the LORD, he arose from before the LORD’s altar, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread out toward heaven.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门在耶和华的坛前屈膝跪着，向天举手，在耶和华面前祷告祈求已毕，就起来，

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門在耶和華的壇前屈膝跪着，向天舉手，在耶和華面前禱告祈求已畢，就起來，

en.text: He stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 站着，大声为以色列全会众祝福，说：

zhTraditional.text: 站着，大聲為以色列全會眾祝福，說：

en.text: “Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.

zhSimplified.text: 「耶和华是应当称颂的！因为他照着一切所应许的赐平安给他的民以色列人，凡借他仆人摩西应许赐福的话，一句都没有落空。

zhTraditional.text: 「耶和華是應當稱頌的！因為他照着一切所應許的賜平安給他的民以色列人，凡藉他僕人摩西應許賜福的話，一句都沒有落空。

en.text: May the LORD our God be with us as he was with our fathers. Let him not leave us or forsake us,

zhSimplified.text: 愿耶和华—我们的 神与我们同在，像与我们列祖同在一样，不撇下我们，不丢弃我们，

zhTraditional.text: 願耶和華－我們的上帝與我們同在，像與我們列祖同在一樣，不撇下我們，不丟棄我們，

en.text: that he may incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers.

zhSimplified.text: 使我们的心归向他，遵行他的道，谨守他吩咐我们列祖的诫命、律例、典章。

zhTraditional.text: 使我們的心歸向他，遵行他的道，謹守他吩咐我們列祖的誡命、律例、典章。

en.text: Let these my words, with which I have made supplication before the LORD, be near to the LORD our God day and night, that he may maintain the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel, as every day requires;

zhSimplified.text: 我在耶和华面前祈求的这些话，愿耶和华—我们的 神昼夜垂念，每日为他仆人与他民以色列伸冤，

zhTraditional.text: 我在耶和華面前祈求的這些話，願耶和華－我們的上帝晝夜垂念，每日為他僕人與他民以色列伸冤，

en.text: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD himself is God. There is no one else.

zhSimplified.text: 使地上的万民都知道惟独耶和华是 神，并无别神。

zhTraditional.text: 使地上的萬民都知道惟獨耶和華是上帝，並無別神。

en.text: “Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as it is today.”

zhSimplified.text: 所以你们当向耶和华—我们的 神存诚实的心，遵行他的律例，谨守他的诫命，至终如今日一样。」 （代下7·4—10）

zhTraditional.text: 所以你們當向耶和華－我們的上帝存誠實的心，遵行他的律例，謹守他的誡命，至終如今日一樣。」 （代下7‧4－10）

en.text: The king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 王和以色列众民一同在耶和华面前献祭。

zhTraditional.text: 王和以色列眾民一同在耶和華面前獻祭。

en.text: Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to the LORD, twenty two thousand head of cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the LORD’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 所罗门向耶和华献平安祭，用牛二万二千，羊十二万。这样，王和以色列众民为耶和华的殿行奉献之礼。

zhTraditional.text: 所羅門向耶和華獻平安祭，用牛二萬二千，羊十二萬。這樣，王和以色列眾民為耶和華的殿行奉獻之禮。

en.text: The same day the king made the middle of the court holy that was before the LORD’s house; for there he offered the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings.

zhSimplified.text: 当日，王因耶和华殿前的铜坛太小，容不下燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油，便将耶和华殿前院子当中分别为圣，在那里献燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油。

zhTraditional.text: 當日，王因耶和華殿前的銅壇太小，容不下燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油，便將耶和華殿前院子當中分別為聖，在那裏獻燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油。

en.text: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven more days, even fourteen days.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，所罗门和以色列众人，就是从哈马口直到埃及小河所有的以色列人，都聚集成为大会，在耶和华—我们的 神面前守节七日又七日，共十四日。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，所羅門和以色列眾人，就是從哈馬口直到埃及小河所有的以色列人，都聚集成為大會，在耶和華－我們的上帝面前守節七日又七日，共十四日。

en.text: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went to their tents joyful and glad in their hearts for all the goodness that the LORD had shown to David his servant, and to Israel his people.

zhSimplified.text: 第八日，王遣散众民；他们都为王祝福。因见耶和华向他仆人大卫和他民以色列所施的一切恩惠，就都心中喜乐，各归各家去了。

zhTraditional.text: 第八日，王遣散眾民；他們都為王祝福。因見耶和華向他僕人大衛和他民以色列所施的一切恩惠，就都心中喜樂，各歸各家去了。
